releases.notes:
New requirements:
- 1.20/1.20.1: Minecraft Forge 46.0.14, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.83.0.
- 1.20.2/1.20.3: Minecraft Forge 48.1.0, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.91.6.
- 1.20.4/1.20.5: Minecraft Forge 49.2.8, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.97.3.
- 1.20.6: Minecraft Forge 50.2.9, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 100.8.
- 1.21/1.21.1: Minecraft Forge 51.0.33, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.102.0, or NeoForge 21.0.167.
- 1.21.3: Minecraft Forge 53.1.11, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.114.1, or NeoForge 21.3.96.
- 1.21.4: Minecraft Forge 54.1.17, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.119.4, or NeoForge 21.4.157.
- 1.21.5: Minecraft Forge 55.1.11, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.128.2, or NeoForge 21.5.97.
- 1.21.8: Minecraft Forge 58.1.19, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.136.1, or NeoForge 21.8.53.
- 1.21.10: Minecraft Forge 60.1.11, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.138.4, or NeoForge 21.10.64.
- 1.21.11: Minecraft Forge 61.1.9, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.141.4, or NeoForge 21.11.42.
- 26.1.2: Minecraft Forge 64.0.11, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.154.2, or NeoForge 26.1.2.80.
- 26.2: Minecraft Forge 65.0.4, or Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Fabric API 0.154.2, or NeoForge 26.2.0.18-beta.
- 26.3: Minecraft Forge 66.0.9, or Fabric Loader 0.19.5 and Fabric API 0.161.0, or NeoForge 26.3.0.45-beta.

Added:
- Shape: Helix (thanks @Scanavium21!).
- Support for Minecraft 26.3.

Fixed:
- Potentially fixed rare rendering issues which cause shape blocks to render at strange angles or not render at all.
- Z-fighting for cube sizes of 1.0.
- Loading failures on certain versions NeoForge.

New requirements are as follows:
- 1.20/1.20.1: Minecraft Forge 46.0.14, or Fabric Loader 0.17.3 and Fabric API 0.83.0.
- 1.20.2/1.20.3: Minecraft Forge 48.1.0, or Fabric Loader 0.17.3 and Fabric API 0.91.6.
- 1.20.4/1.20.5: Minecraft Forge 49.2.2, or Fabric Loader 0.17.3 and Fabric API 0.97.2.
- 1.20.6: Minecraft Forge 50.2.2, or Fabric Loader 0.17.3 and Fabric API 0.100.8.
- 1.21/1.21.1: Minecraft Forge 51.0.33, or Fabric Loader 0.17.3 and Fabric API 0.102.0, or NeoForge 21.0.167.
- 1.21.3: Minecraft Forge 53.1.4, or Fabric Loader 0.17.3 and Fabric API 0.114.1, or NeoForge 21.3.93.
- 1.21.4: Minecraft Forge 54.1.8, or Fabric Loader 0.17.3 and Fabric API 0.119.4, or NeoForge 21.4.155.
- 1.21.5: Minecraft Forge 55.1.2, or Fabric Loader 0.17.3 and Fabric API 0.128.2, or NeoForge 21.5.95.
- 1.21.8: Minecraft Forge 58.1.7, or Fabric Loader 0.17.3 and Fabric API 0.136.0, or NeoForge 21.8.47.

Added:
- Support for Minecraft 1.21.10 and 1.21.11.

Changed:
- Persistent shapes now load when the world loads instead of when the GUI is first opened.

Fixed:
- Key mappings reset using NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.5 and 1.21.8.
- Potential issues when starting the game related to registering shapes.
- Some missing persistence triggers.

Removed:
- Support for Minecraft 1.19.4 and older.
- Debug shape generation timings.

_Revision 1: Removed forgotten debug output in Fabric 1.21.10._

releases.notes:
Forge and Fabric versions are merged into the same jar as of this release.
New requirements are as follows:
- 1.16.5: Minecraft Forge 36.2.39, or Fabric Loader 0.14.8 and Fabric API 0.42.0.
- 1.17.1: Minecraft Forge 37.1.1, or Fabric Loader 0.14.8 and Fabric API 0.44.0.
- 1.18.2: Minecraft Forge 40.1.68, or Fabric Loader 0.14.8 and Fabric API 0.57.0.
- 1.19: Minecraft Forge 41.1.0, or Fabric Loader 0.14.10 and Fabric API 0.58.0.
- 1.19.2: Minecraft Forge 43.0.0, or Fabric Loader 0.14.9 and Fabric API 0.59.0.
- 1.19.3: Minecraft Forge 44.1.0, or Fabric Loader 0.14.12 and Fabric API 0.72.0.
- 1.19.4: Minecraft Forge 45.0.29, or Fabric Loader 0.14.18 and Fabric API 0.76.0.
- 1.20: Minecraft Forge 46.0.2, or Fabric Loader 0.14.21 and Fabric API 0.83.0.

Added:
- Shapes can now be generated asynchronously. This can be configured in the config and is enabled by default.
- Shape names now have indicators whether they are asynchronously generating (spinning line), recently finished generating (green), or ran into an error (red).
- Most shapes now have an 'Even mode' that allows for evenly sized shapes. For example, 4x4, 6x6, 8x8, etc. circles.
- Shape colours can now be randomly generated.
- Shapes can start with randomised colours in Advanced mode using an option in the Visualization screen. The startup state of this option can be configured in the config file.
- Catenary can now be inverted.
- Catenary now has a 'Set endpoint' button to set the second position to the player's position.
- Visualization screen now has a title for rendering-related settings.

Changed:
- Line now uses Catenary's dX,dY,dZ-format as well.
- A lot of parameters are now floating point numbers, which, for example, allow for a radius of 3.672.
- The new shape in Advanced mode now also starts on Circle and remembered inbetween GUI opens.

Fixed:
- The config file now works again because the old system was dropped in favour of a selfmade one.
- The X and Z direction for Torus are no longer swapped.

mods.name: Build Guide
mods.description: A client-side only mod to project shapes like circles and spheres into the world. It works both in singleplayer and multiplayer, even if the server doesn't have the mod installed.

releases.notes:
New requirement is Minecraft Forge 39.0.6.
Added:
- Shape: catenary (aka a chain or rope line).
- Shape: parabola.
- Shape: paraboloid.

Changed:
- Circle is now enforced as the default shape.
- Renamed 'Height' to 'Depth' in circle, ellipse, and polygon parameters as that made more sense.

Fixed:
- Shape generation timing debug output didn't print regardless of the config file in some versions if the logger didn't want to give the mod the right logging level.
